notes.title: A New Adult RPG, Spirits of Retarnia, is Now Available Fully Uncensored!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/975020/The_Spirit_Master_of_Retarnia_Conqueror_of_the_Labyrinth/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/91696482714626633ad05d34d34c8df3e3b987cf.jpg[/img][/url]

If you're a fan of dungeon crawlers and gameplay focused eroge, then get ready for The Spirit Master of Retarnia from MangaGamer and Lunasoft!

Join the Spirit Master of Retarnia in saving the kingdom from the Demon World at the behest of your queen! 
[list]
[*] Explore classic, 3D dungeons with a host of five heroines, each with their own special abilities!
[*]Power up with equipment uncovered in the dungeon, and customize your party's skills as they level up to create the best builds for your style!
[/list] 

It's time to take up your wand and vanquish those threatening harm to the realm!

notes.title: Evenicle v1.04 Patch
notes.content:
Added an option to fix graphics if the screen is not refreshing properly 
(CONFIG - Window - Use Compatibility Mode)

Checking this is not necessary if you haven't experienced any graphical problems with your game.

You can check the version of your game from the help/about in your top menu.

notes.title: Evenicle v1.03 Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33744217/10afb95fecff6c7ba3db25ef1c5c91a15442b168.jpg[/img]
The following updates have been made in this patch:
- Fixes the Steam Overlay
- No longer exits with an error message when loading corrupted global save files
- Option to use censored CGs
(The last page of your config/Game Settings)
- Some typo fixes

Please just let steam auto-update itself.
You can check the version of your game from the help/about in your top menu.
